text:
mike: quick heads-up - post-release telemetry shows increased OOMs in runtime:v4.1 when serving legacy quant models. I'm proposing a scoped pin to runtime:v4.0 for model-group=legacy-quant in NA regions while we triage.

deploy-bot: created pin 'pin-318202' (owners=[mike,sophia], scope=region:us-east,us-west;model_group:legacy-quant; version=runtime:v4.0). Reason: runtime:v4.1 OOMs on legacy-quant models.
sophia: can you attach the sample failure traces and repro steps? Need to know if it's allocator drift vs model-bind ABI.
mike: repro summary: OOM at allocator/buddy_alloc.cpp:312 under concurrent long-seq batch loads. Sample: model=legacy-quant-2 batch=24 seq=4096 -> OOM. CI run link: https://ci.internal/runs/318202/oom-debug.

ci-bot: queued focused repro on na-canary-01 with v4.1 and v4.0. Will run kernel debug flags.

sophia: recommendation: route legacy-quant traffic to runtime:v4.0 for NA and enable verbose allocator metrics. That keeps short requests on v4.1 and preserves capacity. Deploy-bot can do route rewrite by model_group.
deploy-bot: suggested command: `/deploy route-update --match "model.group=legacy-quant" --fallback runtime:v4.0 --scope region:na --dry-run`

ops: add monitoring: alert if OOM rate >0.05% for 10m or if p99 latency >2x. Also surface banner for Dedicated customers in the console.
mike: owners: mike+sophia. Do not release pin until we have reproducible fix OR shim in sdk-client/runtime adapter.

ci-bot: repro result: OOM reproduces on v4.1 only. Heap traces show change in slab size accounting after allocator micro-optim.
sophia: that points to runtime allocator change. I'll prepare a micro-patch to revert the problematic accounting change. Meanwhile agree on routing mitigation.
mike: approve dry-run -> promote routing fallback for legacy-quant on NA. Keep pin active.
deploy-bot: routing promoted at 3182023530 (scope=region:na, match=model.group=legacy-quant, fallback=runtime:v4.0). Dry-run validated. Estimated traffic impact <1.5%.

ops: can we gate the routing change with an auto-rollback if OOMs spike or latency regresses?
deploy-bot: helm: `/deploy route-update --match "model.group=legacy-quant" --fallback runtime:v4.0 --scope region:na --rollback-threshold "oom>0.05%||p99>2x"` (will roll back automatically).

sophia: micro-patch PR opened: runtime#789 - reverts allocator accounting tweak and adds unit test for concurrent slab reuse. CI pending. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/789
mike: once CI green, can we push v4.1.1-canary and run the repro on na-canary-01? If green then follow unpin checklist: 1) repro fixed, 2) 6h soak on canary models, 3) 12h stable in NA with routing still active, then release pin.

ci-bot: CI passed for runtime#789 at 3182023610. Built artifact v4.1.1-canary.
sophia: deploying v4.1.1-canary to na-canary-01 now and will run repro.

[10m later]

sophia: repro against v4.1.1-canary shows no OOMs for the failing workload. Heap metrics stable. Starting 6h soak.
mike: thanks. Reminder: update release notes and add short entry about temporary routing fallback and allocator revert. Also note owners and pin id for audit.

ops: creating console banner for Dedicated: "Temporary routing fallback active for legacy-quant models in NA; engineering investigating OOMs. See incident 318202 for details."
deploy-bot: pin 'pin-318202' remains active. Manual release required: `/deploy pin release pin-318202 --by <owner>`

mike: agreed unpin criteria: 1) canary repro pass + 6h soak, 2) NA metrics stable for 12h post-promotion, 3) release notes + changelog updated, 4) postmortem draft started.
sophia: will monitor and post updates. If something regresses we revert routing and re-enable pin.

ci-bot: soak start time 3182023660. Next status update in thread at soak end or on regression.
